variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: OOTB Marketing Channel captured automatically via Marketing Channel Processing Rules. Populates the Marketing Channel report. Processing rules must be defined (out of scope for SDR).

variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Experience Cloud ID — primary device/visitor identifier set by AEP Web SDK. Mandatory baseline identity variable.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL mirrored from the Page URL eVar for PathFinder and pathing analysis.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit mirrored from the Business Unit eVar for ClickMap and pathing segmentation.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name mirrored from the Page Name eVar for PathFinder pathing across programme and installation pages.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section mirrored from the Site Section eVar for next-page pathing and ClickMap.

variables.name: Programme Title
variables.description: Festival programme/installation title mirrored from the Programme Title eVar for pathing through listings and detail pages.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue name mirrored from the Venue eVar for ClickMap on precinct listings and venue flow analysis.

variables.name: Installation ID
variables.description: Unique installation/programme identifier mirrored from the Installation ID eVar for QR check-in pathing.

variables.name: Content Type
variables.description: Content classification (programme, installation, trail, policy page) mirrored from the Content Type eVar for pathing.

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Self-guided trail name mirrored from the Trail Name eVar for trail selection and progress pathing.

variables.name: Trail Step
variables.description: Current trail step/stop label mirrored from the Trail Step eVar for QR check-in progress pathing.

variables.name: Registration Trigger
variables.description: Registration trigger moment mirrored from the Registration Trigger eVar for funnel pathing by entry point.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Brand Concierge query intent mirrored from the Concierge Intent eVar for conversational pathing and escalation analysis.

variables.name: Venue Crowd Density Tier
variables.description: Live per-venue crowd density tier mirrored from the Crowd Density eVar for map interaction pathing.

variables.name: Consent State
variables.description: Combined cookie/marketing consent state mirrored from the Consent State eVar for consent-respecting pathing segmentation.

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Baseline page-view counter fired on every page load across all SNF website pages.

variables.name: Page Load Time (ms)
variables.description: Baseline page load time in milliseconds (Numeric). Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to enable Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports Core Web Vitals / performance reporting.

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Baseline counter incremented alongside Page Load Time (ms); divisor for the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Email Registration Start
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow (enters email, requests one-time code/link). Journey start event for the registration funnel.

variables.name: Email Registration Verified
variables.description: Fires when a visitor's email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Journey complete event for the registration funnel.

variables.name: Registration Flow Completion
variables.description: Fires on completion of the mobile-optimised email registration flow (final step submitted). Supports mobile-first funnel analysis.

variables.name: Profile Management Interaction
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor views or updates their profile (managed via AEP / RT-CDP).

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants consent under the three-tier model (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Consent tier captured in accompanying eVar.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawal
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings (effective immediately). Supports consent log and RT-CDP suppression.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Decision
variables.description: Fires when a visitor records a cookie consent choice via the PDPA cookie banner/settings (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting). Category selections captured in accompanying eVar.

variables.name: Programme Listing View
variables.description: Fires when festival programme or installation listings are displayed (title, description, venue, dates, times). Supports content display reporting.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Exit/off-site conversion proxy; no ticketing hosted on SNF site.

variables.name: Privacy Policy View
variables.description: Fires on Privacy Policy page views documenting PDPA personal data collection, purpose, retention and visitor rights.

variables.name: Terms Of Use View
variables.description: Fires on Terms of Use page views.

variables.name: Cookie Policy View
variables.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page views documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention period.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap) displaying programme/installation locations. Map implemented by Adobe using MapBox.

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only (derived zone label).

variables.name: Location Permission Denied
variables.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; listings fall back to default (non-degraded) behaviour.

variables.name: Trail Selection
variables.description: Fires when a visitor selects a curated self-guided trail for navigation.

variables.name: Trail Saved / Followed
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and follows a trail (progress tracked via QR check-ins).

variables.name: Itinerary Item Added
variables.description: Fires each time a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for detected itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth).

variables.name: Shared Itinerary Adopted
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (viewable without authentication); triggers a light registration prompt.

variables.name: Community Pick Surfaced
variables.description: Fires when an itinerary reaching ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page.

variables.name: QR Scan
variables.description: Fires when a visitor scans an installation/programme QR code and loads the programme detail page. Installation ID captured in accompanying eVar.

variables.name: QR Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is triggered on an unauthenticated visitor's first QR scan.

variables.name: Confirmed Check-in
variables.description: Fires when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in (installation ID + timestamp). Venue check-in derived from QR, not GPS.

variables.name: Unlocked Content Viewed
variables.description: Fires when scanned-in visitors view optional unlocked content authored per installation in AEMaaCS (no empty state when absent).

variables.name: Your Picks Tonight Impression
variables.description: Fires when the 'Your picks tonight' bookmark-based feed (up to 3 affinity-matched recommendations) is shown to a registered visitor.

variables.name: Trending With Your Circle Chip Shown
variables.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip (session hash clustering) is shown on shared programmes viewed/bookmarked in the same loop.

variables.name: Returning Visitor Banner Shown
variables.description: Fires when a returning visitor is shown the contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops linking to remaining itinerary.

variables.name: Last-Chance Section Impression
variables.description: Fires when the auto-sorted current-night / post-9pm last-chance programme section is surfaced with urgency labels.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Engagement
variables.description: Fires when a visitor engages with Brand Concierge (opens/submits a query). Query intent captured in accompanying eVar. Available to all visitors regardless of registration status.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Escalation / Failure
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction results in escalation or failure (no resolution). Supports escalation/failure rate reporting.

variables.name: Social Share Initiated
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares a programme detail or shareable itinerary page (Open Graph / Twitter Card enriched). Native share surface.

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Isolates production-environment hits by filtering Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment excluding staging/QA traffic from all reporting.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment capturing every qualifying visit to the SNF website. Used as the denominator for visit-scoped rate metrics.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors derived from OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension.

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors derived from OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension. Supports returning-visitor contextual banner analysis (BRD 704).

metrics_segments.name: Authenticated Users
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating registered/authenticated visitors (Login Status eVar = 'authenticated'). Supports registration-gated analysis.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits divided by total visits. Baseline engagement quality indicator.

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: total page views divided by total visits. Baseline depth-of-engagement indicator.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: Calculated metric: registration completions divided by visits. Baseline conversion indicator aligned to the registration funnel.

metrics_segments.name: Verified Registered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who completed email registration verified via one-time code or link. Supports registered-visitor counts and funnel reporting (BRD 201, 1204).

metrics_segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with full content access who have not registered. Confirms registration is optional and unregistered visitors retain unrestricted access (BRD 203).

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent at registration. Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 301, 1204).

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent at registration. Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 301, 1204).

metrics_segments.name: Consent Withdrawn Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports consent-withdrawal monitoring (BRD 303).

metrics_segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who accepted the Analytics & Performance cookie category. Scopes data-collection analysis to consented sessions (BRD 1808, 1809).

metrics_segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with at least one confirmed QR check-in recorded against their profile. Supports QR check-in rate reporting (BRD 604, 1201).

metrics_segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that loaded a programme detail page with unlocked content visible to physically scanned-in visitors (BRD 602, 605).

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with QR check-in progress tracked. Supports trail engagement analysis (BRD 502).

metrics_segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes and installations (BRD 503).

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505).

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visits that performed one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary, triggering the light registration prompt (BRD 506, 507).

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings (BRD 403).

metrics_segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map. Supports map interaction dashboard (BRD 401, 1201).

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site (BRD 105).

metrics_segments.name: Personalised Picks Engaged Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed (BRD 702).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Funnel Starters
metrics_segments.description: Visits that initiated the email registration flow, keyed by registration trigger moment for funnel-by-trigger reporting (BRD 1205, 202).

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Engaged Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visits that interacted with Adobe Brand Concierge. Supports engagement-rate, intent and escalation reporting (BRD 1404, 1405, 1406).

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalated Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visits where a Brand Concierge interaction resulted in escalation or failure. Supports escalation/failure-rate monitoring (BRD 1406).

evars.name: Marketing Channel
evars.description: OOTB Marketing Channel captured automatically via Marketing Channel Processing Rules. Populates the Marketing Channel report. Processing rules must be defined (out of scope for SDR).

evars.name: Campaign Tracking Code
evars.description: Native s.campaign tracking code sourced from the campaign query parameter. Populates Tracking Code / Campaign reports.

evars.name: Campaign Source
evars.description: SAINT Classification of s.campaign — campaign source (utm_source).

evars.name: Campaign Medium
evars.description: SAINT Classification of s.campaign — campaign medium (utm_medium).

evars.name: Campaign Name
evars.description: SAINT Classification of s.campaign — campaign name (utm_campaign).

evars.name: Campaign Content
evars.description: SAINT Classification of s.campaign — campaign content (utm_content).

evars.name: Device Type
evars.description: OOTB mobile/device dimension from the User-Agent. Supports responsive mobile-first delivery reporting (BRD 103).

evars.name: Browser
evars.description: OOTB browser dimension derived from the User-Agent.

evars.name: Operating System
evars.description: OOTB operating system dimension from the User-Agent.

evars.name: Referrer
evars.description: OOTB referring URL captured automatically by AEP Web SDK.

evars.name: Geolocation
evars.description: OOTB geo dimensions (country/region/city) derived server-side from IP. Not raw GPS. GPS is processed client-side only per BRD 1802.

evars.name: New vs. Return Visitor
evars.description: OOTB visitor return-frequency dimension. Supports returning-visitor contextual banner reporting (BRD 704).

evars.name: ECID
evars.description: Experience Cloud ID — primary device/visitor identifier set by AEP Web SDK. Mandatory baseline identity variable.

evars.name: Page URL
evars.description: Full page URL captured on every hit. Mandatory baseline variable; mirrored to a prop.

evars.name: Business Unit
evars.description: Business unit / brand identifier. Mandatory baseline variable; mirrored to a prop.

evars.name: Environment
evars.description: Deployment environment flag used to build the Production Data Only segment.

evars.name: Login / Registration Status
evars.description: Registration/login status of the visitor. Supports email-verified registration tracking (BRD 201) and optional-registration access tracking (BRD 203).

evars.name: Hashed Visitor ID
evars.description: [Hashed — PII] Registered visitor profile ID, SHA-256 hashed in JS before entering the data layer. Used to tie QR check-ins and consent log entries to the profile (BRD 201, 604).

evars.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Destination
evars.description: Off-site ticketing destination label captured when the Klook ticketing CTA is clicked. No ticketing is built on the SNF site (BRD 105).

evars.name: Registration Trigger Moment
evars.description: Context that triggered a registration prompt (e.g. first QR scan, itinerary adoption). Enables funnel reporting by trigger moment (BRD 1205, 603, 506).

evars.name: Page Name
evars.description: Human-readable page name for every hit. Supports programme/installation listing display tracking (BRD 104).

evars.name: Site Section
evars.description: Top-level site section for content grouping (e.g. Programme, Trails, Map, Info). Mirrored to a prop.

evars.name: Page Type
evars.description: Template/page type classification. Distinguishes Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie Policy, programme detail, etc. (BRD 107, 108, 1812).

evars.name: Government Disclaimer Presence
evars.description: Flag indicating the standard government disclaimer rendered on the page (BRD 106).

evars.name: Brand Guideline Compliance Flag
evars.description: Flag indicating page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines (BRD 109).

evars.name: Programme / Installation ID
evars.description: Unique ID of the programme or installation in view. Core content asset dimension for listings and detail pages (BRD 104, 604).

evars.name: Programme / Installation Title
evars.description: Display title of the programme or installation (BRD 104).

evars.name: Venue Name
evars.description: Venue associated with a programme/installation. Supports per-venue reporting and crowd density indicators (BRD 104, 405).

evars.name: First Festival Year
evars.description: AEMaaCS firstFestivalYear content field for the programme/installation (BRD 1104).

evars.name: Unlocked Content Availability
evars.description: Flag indicating optional unlockedContent exists for the installation. No empty-state when absent (BRD 605, 1104).

evars.name: Unlocked Content State
evars.description: Whether unlocked content is locked or revealed to a physically scanned-in visitor on a QR-loaded detail page (BRD 602).

evars.name: Consent Tier Selection
evars.description: Three-tier consent selection captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Multi-value joined where more than one tier accepted (BRD 301, 302).

evars.name: Consent Action
evars.description: Consent action performed (grant/withdraw) via self-service profile settings. Supports consent-log capture (BRD 303, 304).

evars.name: Cookie Consent Category State
evars.description: Cookie consent choices by category (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting). Respected across sessions without a non-essential cookie (BRD 1808, 1809, 1811).

evars.name: Student Cohort Flag
evars.description: Derived student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually (BRD 1806).

evars.name: AEP Profile Segment Membership
evars.description: Key RT-CDP segment membership label for profile/segment reporting (BRD 204, 1204).

evars.name: Map Interaction Type
evars.description: Type of interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap, listing select) built on MapBox (BRD 401, 402).

evars.name: Location Permission State
evars.description: Whether location permission was granted or denied, driving proximity sorting vs. default listing behaviour (BRD 403, 404). Derived zone label only; no raw GPS stored (BRD 1802).

evars.name: Derived Location Zone
evars.description: Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target. Raw GPS never stored server-side (BRD 1802).

evars.name: Trail Name
evars.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail presented, saved or followed (BRD 501, 502).

evars.name: Trail Progress State
evars.description: Trail progress tracked via QR check-ins for registered visitors (BRD 502).

evars.name: Itinerary ID
evars.description: Identifier of a custom itinerary created, shared or adopted (BRD 503, 505, 506).

evars.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
evars.description: Type of detected conflict/inefficiency surfaced as a dismissible, non-blocking inline suggestion (BRD 504).

evars.name: Itinerary Share Method
evars.description: Native device share method used for itinerary sharing; no social OAuth (BRD 505).

evars.name: Community Pick Status
evars.description: Whether an itinerary has reached ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions and surfaces as a Community Pick (BRD 507, 705).

evars.name: QR Code ID
evars.description: Unique QR code identifier assigned to each installation/programme (BRD 601, 604).

evars.name: QR Check-in Timestamp
evars.description: Timestamp of a confirmed QR scan check-in recorded against the registered visitor profile (BRD 604). Check-in data derived from QR only, not GPS (BRD 1803).

evars.name: Programme Sort / Urgency Context
evars.description: Auto-sort context and urgency labelling for programme listings, including post-9pm last-chance section (BRD 701).

evars.name: Personalisation Use Case
evars.description: Active Adobe Target personalisation use case rendered (e.g. Your Picks Tonight, Trending With Your Circle, returning-visitor banner). Supports Target activity reporting (BRD 702, 703, 704, 706, 1203).

evars.name: Session Hash Cluster ID
evars.description: Session hash clustering key used for the 'Trending with your circle' chip when shared programmes are viewed/bookmarked in the same loop (BRD 703).

evars.name: Brand Concierge Intent
evars.description: Classified visitor intent for Brand Concierge interactions (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general festival info). Supports engagement/intent reporting (BRD 1405, 1406).

evars.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
evars.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (resolved, escalated, failed) for escalation/failure rate reporting (BRD 1406).

events.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page views documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention period.

events.name: Map Interaction
events.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap) displaying programme/installation locations. Map implemented by Adobe using MapBox.

events.name: Location Permission Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only (derived zone label).

events.name: Location Permission Denied
events.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; listings fall back to default (non-degraded) behaviour.

events.name: Trail Selection
events.description: Fires when a visitor selects a curated self-guided trail for navigation.

events.name: Trail Saved / Followed
events.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and follows a trail (progress tracked via QR check-ins).

events.name: Itinerary Item Added
events.description: Fires each time a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary.

events.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
events.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for detected itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies.

events.name: Itinerary Shared
events.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth).

events.name: Shared Itinerary Adopted
events.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (viewable without authentication); triggers a light registration prompt.

events.name: Community Pick Surfaced
events.description: Fires when an itinerary reaching ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page.

events.name: QR Scan
events.description: Fires when a visitor scans an installation/programme QR code and loads the programme detail page. Installation ID captured in accompanying eVar.

events.name: QR Registration Prompt Shown
events.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is triggered on an unauthenticated visitor's first QR scan.

events.name: Confirmed Check-in
events.description: Fires when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in (installation ID + timestamp). Venue check-in derived from QR, not GPS.

events.name: Unlocked Content Viewed
events.description: Fires when scanned-in visitors view optional unlocked content authored per installation in AEMaaCS (no empty state when absent).

events.name: Your Picks Tonight Impression
events.description: Fires when the 'Your picks tonight' bookmark-based feed (up to 3 affinity-matched recommendations) is shown to a registered visitor.

events.name: Trending With Your Circle Chip Shown
events.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip (session hash clustering) is shown on shared programmes viewed/bookmarked in the same loop.

events.name: Returning Visitor Banner Shown
events.description: Fires when a returning visitor is shown the contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops linking to remaining itinerary.

events.name: Last-Chance Section Impression
events.description: Fires when the auto-sorted current-night / post-9pm last-chance programme section is surfaced with urgency labels.

events.name: Brand Concierge Engagement
events.description: Fires when a visitor engages with Brand Concierge (opens/submits a query). Query intent captured in accompanying eVar. Available to all visitors regardless of registration status.

events.name: Brand Concierge Escalation / Failure
events.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction results in escalation or failure (no resolution). Supports escalation/failure rate reporting.

events.name: Social Share Initiated
events.description: Fires when a visitor shares a programme detail or shareable itinerary page (Open Graph / Twitter Card enriched). Native share surface.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Isolates production-environment hits by filtering Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment excluding staging/QA traffic from all reporting.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Baseline segment capturing every qualifying visit to the SNF website. Used as the denominator for visit-scoped rate metrics.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors derived from OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension.

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors derived from OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension. Supports returning-visitor contextual banner analysis (BRD 704).

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating registered/authenticated visitors (Login Status eVar = 'authenticated'). Supports registration-gated analysis.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits divided by total visits. Baseline engagement quality indicator.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: total page views divided by total visits. Baseline depth-of-engagement indicator.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: Calculated metric: registration completions divided by visits. Baseline conversion indicator aligned to the registration funnel.

segments.name: Verified Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who completed email registration verified via one-time code or link. Supports registered-visitor counts and funnel reporting (BRD 201, 1204).

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with full content access who have not registered. Confirms registration is optional and unregistered visitors retain unrestricted access (BRD 203).

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent at registration. Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 301, 1204).

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent at registration. Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 301, 1204).

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports consent-withdrawal monitoring (BRD 303).

segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who accepted the Analytics & Performance cookie category. Scopes data-collection analysis to consented sessions (BRD 1808, 1809).

segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with at least one confirmed QR check-in recorded against their profile. Supports QR check-in rate reporting (BRD 604, 1201).

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Visits that loaded a programme detail page with unlocked content visible to physically scanned-in visitors (BRD 602, 605).

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with QR check-in progress tracked. Supports trail engagement analysis (BRD 502).

segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes and installations (BRD 503).

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505).

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visits that performed one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary, triggering the light registration prompt (BRD 506, 507).

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings (BRD 403).

segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map. Supports map interaction dashboard (BRD 401, 1201).

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site (BRD 105).

segments.name: Personalised Picks Engaged Visitors
segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed (BRD 702).

segments.name: Registration Funnel Starters
segments.description: Visits that initiated the email registration flow, keyed by registration trigger moment for funnel-by-trigger reporting (BRD 1205, 202).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Engaged Visits
segments.description: Visits that interacted with Adobe Brand Concierge. Supports engagement-rate, intent and escalation reporting (BRD 1404, 1405, 1406).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalated Visits
segments.description: Visits where a Brand Concierge interaction resulted in escalation or failure. Supports escalation/failure-rate monitoring (BRD 1406).
